title: A field extension is regular exactly when it is separable
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies regularity of a field extension with separability. One direction uses that regularity makes the extension geometrically reduced, which by the standard characterisation of separable field extensions gives separability. The converse uses that a separable extension is a filtered colimit of smooth algebras over the base field, which by the earlier colimit result makes the extension regular.
